card.name: Linking words before example drug names
card.fires_on: The word "as" in "such as" (also a comma or "and" in a list) right before a named example drug or substance, mostly after alpha-adrenergic blockers or agonists. Also the start of "d" in dizziness or drowsiness within symptom lists.

modes.label: such as before example
modes.description: "as" in "such as" introducing a drug example after an adrenergic drug class.

modes.label: list separators
modes.description: A comma or "and" in a list of substances, just before the next item.
modes.example: thallium-activated sodium iodide, zinc sulfide<<,>> and organic compounds such as anthracene

modes.label: symptom list start
modes.description: The first letter of dizziness or drowsiness in an overdose symptom list.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens look unrelated and mostly start with "bi".
card.plain: It fires on the small word that comes just before an example drug name in a list, such as "such as" after a blocker class.
